blocks.heading: Our Wildlife Services
blocks.intro: From obtaining official entry permits to coordinating luxury stays and local excursions, we provide seamless end-to-end safari planning.

items.title: Maruti Gypsy Safari Booking
items.text: Exclusive and sharing 4x4 open Gypsy safaris across Zones 1 to 10 with verified entry permits, licensed drivers, and certified nature guides.

items.title: Canter Safari Booking
items.text: Economical 20-seater open safari bus permits ideal for families, groups, and last-minute travellers with panoramic elevated forest views.

items.title: Resort & Jungle Camp Stays
items.text: Curated bookings at handpicked heritage jungle resorts, eco-cottages, and 5-star wilderness retreats near National Park entry gates.

items.title: Railway Station & Airport Transfers
items.text: Comfortable private AC cabs from Sawai Madhopur Junction, Jaipur International Airport, or Delhi NCR straight to your resort.

items.title: Ranthambore Fort & Chambal Safari
items.text: Guided cultural excursions to the 10th-century UNESCO World Heritage Ranthambore Fort, Trinetra Ganesha Temple, and Chambal boat safari.

items.title: Bespoke Wildlife Photography Tours
items.text: Specialized arrangements for photographers featuring exclusive Gypsy positioning, expert trackers, beanbag mounts, and optimal lighting routes.

blocks.heading: National Chambal Gharial Sanctuary Boat Safari
blocks.body:
Located 45 km from Sawai Madhopur at Pali Ghat, the National Chambal Sanctuary is India’s premier clean river sanctuary. Glide along the pristine waters on a silent motorboat to witness critically endangered Gharials, Marsh Crocodiles, and migratory birds.

- Boat Duration: 1 Hour guided ride with certified river lifejackets
- Departure Shifts: 08:00 AM, 11:00 AM, 02:00 PM & 04:00 PM
- Roundtrip private taxi transfer arranged directly from your resort

blocks.heading: UNESCO World Heritage Ranthambore Fort Trek
blocks.intro: 10th-Century Chauhan Dynasty Citadel overlooking the tiger reserve

items.title: Trinetra Ganesh Temple
items.text: One of India's oldest sacred temples where devotees send wedding invitations to Lord Ganesha, situated at the fort summit.

items.title: Padam Talao Lake Viewpoint
items.text: Offers breathtaking panoramic views overlooking the core forest, Padam Talao, and Rajbagh ruins where tigers are frequently seen below.

items.title: Govt. Certified Guide Service
items.text: Local guides who narrate the rich siege history of Raja Hammir Dev, royal stepwells (Baoris), and ancient palaces inside the ramparts.

blocks.heading: Intercity Cab Transfers & Station Pickups
blocks.intro: Reliable, sanitized AC tourist vehicles with experienced highway drivers.
